dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave spline curvature from the sub-apex region to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is rounded with a small radius of curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin displays a steep linear-to-convex incline approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured base width to maximum vertical height ratio is approximately 1.9:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of light-colored vertical linear striations (rake marks) on the lateral surface and a distinct notch at the posterior junction of the trailing edge and the back.
other_distinctive_markers: Numerous high-contrast specular reflections from water droplets adhere to the lower third of the visible skin surface.
